label: Email Access
description: Sign in to a mailbox with its address and password. Mail uses two separate protocols, one per direction: IMAP reads what arrives, SMTP sends. Fill the half you need (both, to receive and send through one connection). Works with every provider that serves them, which is essentially all of them: Gmail (imap.gmail.com / smtp.gmail.com, with an app password), Outlook, Fastmail, iCloud, a company server, a self-hosted box.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.placeholder: For Gmail/Outlook: an app password, not the account password

fields.name: imap_host
fields.label: Incoming server (IMAP)
fields.placeholder: imap.gmail.com (leave empty if you only send)

fields.name: smtp_host
fields.label: Outgoing server (SMTP)
fields.placeholder: smtp.gmail.com (leave empty if you only receive)

fields.name: send_as
fields.label: Send as
fields.placeholder: Only if you send from an alias: Your Name <alias@example.com>

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: The mailbox's access: wire it into the email trigger and action nodes.
